summary: Swept-strut contact solver on the vehicle physics node. First advances each strut position (strut+148/+152/+156) with a velocity-scaled Euler step over the strut array (this+0x134, stride 316, count this+0x130). Then, for struts with both a linked node (+268) and a contact feature (+272), sweeps the travel axis over a small window, calling VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation and TireForceSolver at the strut, its linked node and its feature, and commits the sample position that maximizes contact force. Called by PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff (00401C90).

local_names.this: vehicle physics node carrying the strut array
local_names.a2: frame delta used as the Euler step scale
local_names.v21: best (maximum) contact force found across sweep samples

operations.description: Both per-strut loops are gated on the strut count this+0x130 being greater than 0 (packet guard)
First loop walks the strut array at base this+0x134 with byte stride 316, once per strut in this+0x130
Euler position advance: reads the travel scale at strut+24 and per-strut velocity terms, then writes the new position to strut+148/+152/+156 as scaled sums
Second loop walks the same strut array; each strut is processed only when its linked node (strut+268) and contact feature (strut+272) pointers are both non-zero
VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation run for the strut, its linked node and its contact feature, each followed by TireForceSolver on the contact state at +112/+116/+120

Sweep loop: steps the travel position from strut+24 minus 0.045000002 upward by 0.0099999998 while strut+24 plus 0.050000001 is still above it, re-running the suspension and tire solvers at every sample
Tracks the minimum and maximum contact force across sweep samples and keeps the travel value that produced the maximum force
Commits the chosen sweep position by writing the final sample position to strut+148/+152/+156
Invoked by PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff (00401C90) as the first stage of the per-frame collision pass
